what_this_is: Reads one video file with ffprobe and prints its width and height in pixels, its frame rate and its duration in seconds. Decodes nothing. Refuses a file with no video stream or no usable frame rate.

payload.label: Read a video's width, height, frame rate and length (runs on your computer)
payload.job: Give a check the shape of a video file: width, height, frame rate and duration, from its container
